newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Atlas Copco buys Prime Service.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Copco buys Prime Service.

text.p: Investcorp said on Tuesday it had completed the sale of 74 percent of machinery leasing Prime Service Inc to Atlas Copco for $1.16 billion.

Investcorp, a Bahrain-based international investment bank, said in a statement that it, international clients and Prime Service management had originally acquired the Houston-based firm in December, 1994 for about $300 million including debt.
The statement said Atlas Copco was paying $32 a share in the friendly takeover, placing the value of Prime Service at $1.16 billion including $260 million in debt.
Under Investcorp, Prime Service's revenue grew to around $330 million in 1996 from $212 million the previous year, the statement added.
The Atlas Copco AB purchase is expected to accelerate consolidation in the U.S. equipment rental market and boost sales for the Swedish firm's existing U.S. subsidiaries.
